description: Offline deterministic tabular data ops over local JSON/CSV files (query, filter, join, aggregate)

capabilities.description: Reads rows from a JSON/CSV file with optional predicate match, projection, sort, and limit
Filters rows from a JSON/CSV file by predicate match
Joins two JSON/CSV files with inner/left semantics on key columns
Groups rows and computes count/sum/avg/min/max aggregations
